build_mcp_oauth_provider: build an MCP OAuth provider for a server using the MCPOAuthManager singleton via get_manager()
create_oauth_entry: create a per-server OAuth entry with server URL, config, and provider caching in MCPOAuthManager
test_disk_change_detection: test the mtime-based disk watch that detects external token refreshes and forces SDK reload
run_401_dedup_handler: run the 401 handler with thundering-herd deduplication to coordinate concurrent auth recovery
remove_oauth_provider: remove an OAuth provider from cache and delete its tokens from disk by server name
